projects.hitshop: HitShop is a modern and comprehensive e-commerce mobile application. It provides users with a seamless shopping experience, allowing them to browse products, search items, view detailed product pages, and manage their favorites within a clean and intuitive interface. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, the app follows MVVM Clean Architecture and modern Android development best practices, including dependency injection with Hilt and local data persistence using Room.
projects.smartcampus: A location-based smart campus safety and health notification system designed to provide real-time emergency alerts within a campus environment. The application visualizes incidents on a map based on severity levels and sends instant push notifications to users. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Firebase, the system enables administrators to create and manage emergency alerts, while users receive real-time updates through Firebase Cloud Messaging.
projects.erayai: Kendi özgeçmişim ve verilerimle çalışan, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tabanlı kişisel yapay zeka asistanı. FAISS vektör veritabanı ve Sentence Transformers kullanarak kullanıcı sorularını işleyen sistem, LangGraph ile yönetilen dinamik bir akışa sahiptir. Retrieval kalitesi düştüğünde sorguyu otomatik olarak yeniden yazarak (query rewrite) bağlam doğruluğunu artırır. Backend'de FastAPI ve yerel LLM (Ollama/LLaMA 3.1) kullanılırken, frontend tarafı React ile sıfırdan geliştirilmiştir. Proje, chunk stratejisi ve bağlam (context) yönetimi gibi ileri düzey RAG mimarilerini uçtan uca sergilemektedir.
